travel.musafirModeDesc: I am a traveller (musafir). Apply qasr to applicable prayers.
travel.musafirAlertBody:
Qasr (shortening) reduces Dhuhr, Asr, and Isha from 4 to 2 rakat.

Note: Jama (combining prayers) is not automatically applied due to scholarly differences. Please follow your local scholar or madhab regarding combining prayers during travel.
travel.fiqhNote: Fajr and Maghrib are not shortened (qasr applies to 4-rakat prayers only). Jama (combining prayers) requires following your local scholar or madhab ruling.
travel.recalcNote: Prayer times will be recalculated for your travel destination.

qibla.locationRequiredSubtitle: Set your location in Settings to find the Qibla direction.

fasting.sunnahSourceNote: Fasting Mondays & Thursdays: Sahih Muslim 1162. The White Days (13th–15th of each Hijri month): Sunan an-Nasa'i 2345, Sunan Abi Dawud 2449.

qada.fiqhNote: During an excused period (such as menstruation or postnatal bleeding), a woman does not pray — and those missed prayers are not made up (qada) afterward. This is different from fasting: fasts missed during that time ARE made up later.
qada.consultScholar: This reflects the majority position. For your specific situation, consult your local scholar.

jumuah.kahfVirtueBody: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever reads Surah al-Kahf on the day of Jumu'ah, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays."
jumuah.kahfVirtueCitation: Reported by al-Hakim and al-Bayhaqi; graded authentic by al-Albani

welcome.title: Welcome to PrayCalc
welcome.desc: Accurate prayer times, Qibla direction, and the Islamic calendar — set up in a few taps.

location.title: Your Location
location.prime: PrayCalc uses your location to calculate exact prayer times for your city. It stays on your device — we never share it. Tap Allow on the next screen to continue.

notifications.title: Prayer Reminders
notifications.prime: Get a gentle reminder or the adhan at each prayer time so you never miss a salah. You can fine-tune which prayers notify you afterwards.

method.title: Calculation Method
method.dpcExplain: DPC (Dynamic PrayCalc) automatically computes the best times for your location — an improvement on the Moonsighting method. We recommend keeping it.

done.title: You're all set
done.desc: Your prayer times are ready. You can change any of these choices anytime in Settings.

consent.title: Anonymous Usage Analytics
consent.description: Share anonymous, aggregate usage data to help us improve PrayCalc. No personal information, location, or account details are ever collected.
consent.privacyNote: Off by default. Nothing is sent unless you turn this on, and you can change it anytime.
consent.privacyScreenFooter: PrayCalc is privacy-first. Analytics are anonymous and off unless you opt in. Turning this off stops all telemetry immediately.
